answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a scarce token for a week before it may vote or earn reputation, then slash that deposit if the identity is caught coordinating duplicate claims. Splitting one attacker’s influence across a hundred accounts now requires a hundred deposits and exposes each to loss; the attacker also waits a week before gaining value. The ocean of possible aliases meets a real price, while an ember of suspicion can trigger review across a grove of linked accounts.
